property_summary: For any address a the owner installs via setOperator, the onlyOperator gate must admit an address x (checked behaviorally via depositAndStake's revert outcome) exactly when x equals the explicitly installed operator a; in particular the contract itself must never be admitted unless explicitly installed, but the mutant stores address(this) for a == address(0) and thereby wrongly admits c.
change_summary: Set operator to the owner's choice only when it is nonzero, otherwise store address(0) — differing from P for zero-address calls.
